Description_of_Deviation: Approximately midway through the Dorsal Foot Vein protocol, catheter patency was lost causing fluctuating results. This was a physiological response to having a catheter in a very small, superficial vessel with a very slow flow rate (as per protocol.) This is an extremely rare but not a wholly unexpected risk. It was not detrimental to the subject in any way as the catheter did not infiltrate. Once determined, testing was halted. The study nurse examined the site and neither redness nor swelling was observed. The subject also reported no discomfort or pain.
Deviation_Action: Repeat Test (Requires approval by FAP Personnel)
Remedy: The Cardio Vascular team would like the opportunity to repeat this test Tuesday afternoon (5/13/08) or Wednesday morning (5/14/08). If allowed, we will attempt testing in the opposite foot. If unsuccessful, we will not make a second attempt at repeating this data collection. Written status of this repeated data collection will be sent to FAP as a follow-up upon completion of the test.
